THE COMPANY AGREES TO:
1. Assign a supervisor to oversee the intern during the internship period.

2. Give IT-related work assignments to the intern. 3. Provide the necessary safety instructions throughout the student’s training period. 4. Adhere to all regulations regarding employment, labor laws, and health and safety laws. 5. Report to the internship coordinator as soon as possible when problems arise involving the intern. 6. Notify the internship coordinator in advance if plans are made to terminate or alter the position of the
intern. 7. Evaluate the intern and the internship program at the end of the internship period. 8. Issue certificate of completion to the student intern not later than two weeks after the completion of
internship. THE STUDENT AGREES TO:
1. Perform tasks and activities indicated in the internship plan. 2. Comply with the requirements of the contract including the rules and regulations of the company at all
times. ACO-CI-F-001(001) Page 1 of 2

INTERNSHIP AGREEMENT
3. Report for internship based on the schedule indicated in the internship agreement . 4. Report job problems to his/her training supervisor and to the internship coordinator. 5. Maintain confidentiality, during and after the internship period of all data or business process which is not
within the public domain and is indicated or understood to be confidential. 6.

Complete the internship within the agreed period. 7. Be terminated from the program should he/she withdraw from school or fail the internship program. THE SCHOOL AGREES TO:
1. Directly supervise the internship program through the internship coordinator of the College of Computing
and Information Technologies. 2. Provide the necessary instructions to the intern through the internship coordinator prior to his/her job
placement. 3. Conduct inspection of the internship company to ensure safety of student interns . 4. Cover the student’s insurance and monitor his/her attendance at both school and work as per school
policy. Note: This memorandum is for the purpose of outlining the agreement between the school and the company
on the conditions of training given to a student while on the job. We, the undersigned, agree to the
conditions and statements in this agreement and give consent to them. Date
